verdict.rationale: Relay's docs and community evidence show a consolidated platform covering banking (multiple checking accounts), cards with spend controls, bill pay with approvals/vendor payments, invoicing/AR, expense categorization/accounting sync, and high-yield savings — directly replacing separate spend, bill pay, and banking tools. Independent community review corroborates automatic money partitioning and multi-account use, though notes manual execution for some external payments. Missing for 10: deeper independent verification of full spend-management/expense-categorization workflow and more robust third-party proof of true 'replace multiple tools' consolidation in practice.
